breaking.change: Each size's type is one step larger: sm text-sm, md text-base, lg text-lg, so a primary label reads at body size and a secondary at 14 px or more on a 720p frame. RpgItemCard's Equip and Drop are lg.
breaking.fix: A button that must keep the former type passes its own text-* class.

breaking.change: The default pack's current menu entry is a warm-white leading bar over a translucent plate with a soft glow, in the fg ink, not a filled cyan block; its wordmark is text-display-3xl with tight tracking; its fallback ground is graded cool to warm under a warm light.
breaking.fix: A pack that wants the former look sets these slots in its variants.

breaking.change: RpgItemCard and SettingsScreen now apply the rarity and selected variants (a variant behind a data-* prefix never expanded). Every rarity past common gets a glow in its own colour, epic and higher a 2 px rim, and the card's header a radial light in the rarity's colour.
breaking.fix: A pack that relied on the variants being inert sets them to what it wants shown.

breaking.fix: A game that wants the former sizes passes its own classes or sets these slots.
